work.author: Masoretic textual tradition
work.description: The consonantal, vocalized, and accentuated Hebrew and Aramaic textual tradition represented by identified manuscripts and print editions. Edition records distinguish their base text, editors, apparatus, and delivery artifacts; this identity does not collapse differences among the Bomberg tradition, Codex Leningradensis, Biblia Hebraica printings, or modern critical editions.
